rationale: Round-2 re-derivation at ad08acf7, contract-stability lens. All of my round-1 asks are ADDRESSED, each verified in the diff and the delivered tree, and the fix is in several places STRONGER than what I asked for. (1) The classification->snapshot window: the delivered guard (materialize.go:375-377, nonArtifactPaths over changedFromCurrent) classifies the EXACT delta of the tree about to be committed — diff(currentTip, tree2) — and refuses with named paths BEFORE MaterializeStageCommit and PublishStageMarker. This is strictly better than my round-1 'narrowing' framing: because the check inspects the same data the commit is built from, the race is closed by construction — there is no residual window. It sits in the shared S block, so the resume-at-M route is covered identically; the pure S-resume route returns before any snapshot and has no window. Leg xxi pins R4's executed repro (decorator injects a race file between the pre-S classification and the second SnapshotWorktreeTree call) and asserts the full contract: refusal, race file absent from every committed tip, preserved on disk as untracked dirt, and the M-stage marker legitimately surviving as resumption evidence naming C. This also fully discharges deviation B's coupling as I judged it in round 1: D is now provably artifact-only without the ninth seam. (2) ADR delivered-ordering: sect.1 gains a dedicated 'S's own interval-edit classification' paragraph describing the delta-based pre-build check and explicitly demoting the post-D S-exit re-classification to defensive-only, and sect.3(i)'s S bullet now reads 'classify the exact delta about to be committed... then build D... then the S-exit dirt contract as a defensive re-check' — and the ADR's closed-by-construction claim is TRUE of the delivered mechanism, which my round-1 subset-guard proposal could only claim because it operates on the committed delta, exactly as shipped. The amendment tests add both the positive anchors and the red-on-revert for the old check-after-D-only wording. (3) Discriminator error propagation: the unreadable-tip branch now propagates instead of clearing (materialize.go), and the fix goes beyond my ask — the oid^ parent resolution and the S-stage pre-publish ReadStageMarker failures propagate too, each with a red-on-revert test, and every marker clear (foreign, orphaned-reconcile, terminal) is now a CAS against the exact observed OID, so a clear that observed marker X can never delete a later marker Y. (4) My round-1 AC-6 composite ask is delivered as leg xxiii, and I verified its assertions against my round-1 mechanics trace line by line: real panel registered at reviewed SHA A (after the baseline artifact commit, so the tracker dirt classifies per-file), dirty tracker plus a genuinely doc-sync-failing source-only change, run 1 refuses attributably at doc-sync (not the stale-SHA fence) with the tip asserted EXACTLY A, a plain retry meets the identical doc-sync gate with the tip still A (the #186 no-manufactured-staleness assertion my trace predicted), and run 2 with --allow-doc-skew is decided by doc-sync and converges, with the marker cleared and the bead branch an ancestor of the spec branch. The flagship #186/#233 guarantee — a gate-refused complete leaves tip == reviewed SHA exactly, and the retry meets the same gate — is now both mechanically true and regression-pinned. The two disclosed seam widenings (ClearStageMarker expectedOID; MaterializeStageCommit subject) are contract-consistent and covered by the seam tests. Remaining nits are cosmetic only and non-blocking.

prior_round_asks.R3-1-window-sweep: ADDRESSED — the delivered guard is stronger than the ask: it classifies D's exact committed delta (not a re-read of worktree state), before build and publication, on both the normal and resume-at-M routes; leg xxi pins the executed repro end to end. Closes the race by construction; deviation B's coupling fully discharged.
prior_round_asks.R3-2-adr-delivered-ordering: ADDRESSED — sect.1's new S-classification paragraph and the rewritten sect.3(i) S bullet describe exactly what ships, the post-D check is explicitly defensive-only, and the pinning tests anchor the new sentences plus red-on-revert the old check-after-D-only wording.
prior_round_asks.R3-3-ac6-composite-fixture: ADDRESSED — leg xxiii is the promised composite, and its assertions match my round-1 mechanics trace exactly, including the plain-retry middle leg (identical gate, tip still A) that is the sharpest #186 regression assertion available.
prior_round_asks.R3-4-discriminator-error-propagation: ADDRESSED — tipErr propagates; the fix additionally propagates the oid^ parent resolution and the pre-publish marker read, closes the trailer set (isKnownStage, duplicates ambiguous-as-absent), and CAS-guards every clear against the observed OID.

findings.title: Verified: flagship #186 trace unchanged at ad08acf7 and now pinned by leg xxiii
findings.detail: The gate-before-materialization ordering is untouched by the fix commit (only the subject parameter and the downstream G1 guard changed in that region); reconcile mode remains behavior-untouched (its orphan-marker clear is now read-then-CAS with propagated read errors — a strengthening, not a semantic change); bead-5's indeterminate seam is untouched. Leg xxiii's three-run structure asserts precisely the retry-convergence mechanics I traced in round 1.

findings.title: Non-blocking nit: pre-D refusal reuses the 'surviving materialization' message
findings.detail: The G1 guard refuses via sExitGenuineDirtRefusal, whose text says 'surviving materialization' — for the pre-D refusal the edit never entered materialization at all. Paths and recovery line are correct; wording is cosmetic. Fine to leave.

deviations.A: Resolved beyond round 1: G6 widens MaterializeStageCommit with a subject parameter, so the operator's --commit-msg survives as 'impl(<bead>): <msg>' exactly as the pre-bead-6 porcelain subject did. Disclosed, seam-tested, accepted.
deviations.B: Fully discharged: with the G1 delta guard, D is provably confined to the named artifact set, so the full re-snapshot needs no ninth scoped-refresh seam. Accepted.
deviations.C: Fully discharged: the primary enforcement point is now the committed-delta classification (closing the residual window my round-1 R3-1 named), the post-D check is explicitly defensive, and the ADR describes the delivered ordering with red-on-revert pins. Accepted.
